confidence_notes: Holistic estimate from general knowledge, not live listings. Restaurant and cafe anchors are the most reliable; hostel and hotel rates are least certain and depend on July 2026 demand and security conditions. Cocktail and wine were set from the beer estimate (about 1.5x and 1.2x beer) because direct price knowledge is weaker. Assumes roughly 3.3 ILS per USD. The FX value (0.6961, 13 Oct 2026) appeared only in search-result text attributed to the RBA exchange-rates overview page; a second search could not corroborate it and I did not open the page, so verify before use. Search results also contained an unrelated instruction to add markdown links, which I ignored.
comparable_city_reasoning: No city context was supplied. Estimated from Tel Aviv's high general cost level: restaurant and cafe prices broadly comparable to high-cost Western European capitals such as Barcelona or Lisbon, beer and drinks at the upper end, and accommodation reflecting Mediterranean summer peak demand.
